import { expect, it } from 'vitest';

const SPEC_RE = /\.test\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;

// The `.test(` below is a member call, not a test declaration. A rule keying on
// a word boundary alone starts its block there — and that block holds the
// concurrency primitive while closing long before this call's own trailing
// timeout argument, so a correctly written test reads as an untimed one.
it('classifies every path off the main thread', async () => {
  const paths = ['scan.test.ts', 'helpers/worker.ts'];
  if (SPEC_RE.test(String(await Promise.all(paths.map(async (p) => p))))) {
    expect(paths).toHaveLength(2);
  }
}, 30_000);
